modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Every passenger may carry one cabin bag and one personal item, including Star Alliance Gold members.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Cabin bag max 118 cm (55x40x23 cm). Business Class may also bring a foldable garment bag of 57x54x15 cm as its second piece.

weight_economy.value: Economy Class: 1 cabin bag, max 8 kg.

weight_business.value: Business Class: 2 cabin bags, max 8 kg per piece; in exceptional cases, depending on the aircraft, Business Class may be limited to 1 item.

personal_item.value: One additional handbag (e.g. a handbag, laptop bag or briefcase), max 4 kg and 40x30x10 cm, in both Economy and Business.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: The free checked allowance on Croatia Airlines flights depends on the fare family.

allowance_by_fare.value: Adults and children: FlyEasy no checked bag; FlyOpti and FlyFlexi 1 x 23 kg; FlyBWise and FlyBizz 2 x 32 kg. Miles & More Frequent Traveller (silver), HON Circle, Senator and Star Gold members get more.

size_limit.value: Maximum size per piece, regardless of class: a + b + c = max. 158 cm.

flyeasy_bag_fee.value: A first bag on a FlyEasy ticket costs, per direction, 16 € + 25 % VAT within Croatia or 30 € on international flights if bought up to 24 hours before the flight; 24 € + 25 % VAT or 40 € within 24 hours of departure. The fee is non refundable.

infant_buggy.value: Children under 4 may also carry one collapsible buggy.

phone_home_market.notes: Croatia Airlines official customer support line.
